capabilities: Sync Things3 Logbook completions and cancellations into daily notes
Create missing daily notes for days with synced items
Show a sidebar review calendar with completion counts, streaks and totals
Save day ratings and short reflections to daily-note frontmatter
Fall back to AppleScript when macOS blocks database access
disambiguation: Not a general utility bundle; it only syncs Things3 completions into daily notes and adds a review calendar.
extras: Direct SQLite access may require Full Disk Access; otherwise the plugin uses AppleScript automation permission. Settings tab shows current access status and links to the relevant macOS privacy panes.
intentEvidence: derived from the MIT-licensed Things Logbook plugin by Liam Cain
problem: Things3 keeps a Logbook of finished tasks, but Obsidian daily notes have no record of what was completed on each day.

relations.evidence: derived from the MIT-licensed Things Logbook plugin by Liam Cain
Things Toolkit connects Things3 with Obsidian daily notes.

summary: Syncs completed and canceled Things3 Logbook items into Obsidian daily notes and adds a sidebar review calendar with ratings and reflections.
